text_block_list.text:
The day following my impactful first
encounter with Эйр Грув, I
overhear a
frantic voice in the hallway.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wh-why won't you listen to me? I'm Air
Groove's trainer, am I not?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy respects its students'
autonomy above all else. That
is why the
student council system exists to begin
with.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But if she attempts to keep up with
student council activities and
tutoring, it
will hinder her own growth. So please!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув has joined the student council
with clear intention and
purpose. No one
can have her abdicate the role but herself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Have you consulted with her on the matter
of quitting the student
council?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: W-well...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Trainer

text_block_list.text: No, I can't recall her ever doing so.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув? But why are you here right
now?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Trainer

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to have let this disturb you, Miss
President. I'll talk to her
alone from here.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I'll be on my way then. Just...
don't be too hard on her,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...I'll try.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Now then... I think you've overstepped the
line.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Wait—please listen to what I have to say!
I'm just worried that you
might be
spending your precious time on things that
don't matter!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Things that "don't matter"? If that's how
you see it, then I see no
further point
trying to reason with you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
No... Why? Don't you want to be winning
races? You need to consider
how you
manage the time you spend!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Winning races, you say... If that's your sole
concern, then I'm afraid we
were never
going to see eye-to-eye.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
This conversation is finished. Consider our
contract void as of this
very moment. Now,
if you'll excuse me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Oh brother, there she goes doin' it again.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
YЭпизод Honestly, I'm not sure if she'll ever
find a trainer who lives up to
her crazy
standards...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Wait, you've been starin' at Эйр Грув all
slack-jawed again?! You
don't learn either,
do you?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, but wait. I guess this would be
something of a chance for you
then, huh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Look at that! You could go over and try to
scout her right now!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Course, as you saw just now, the Empress
isn't exactly easy to win
over. If I were you,
I'd take my time and—oh. Welp, so much
for
waiting.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Determined not to miss this opportunity, I
quickly chase after Air
Groove. Upon
reaching the boulevard outside the school
building,
she stops and gives a sigh of
frustration.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good heavens... For a school as prestigious
as Tracen, it sure does
seem to be lacking
in quality trainers as of late.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
If only there were someone I could fully
place my trust in...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Эйр Грув, I've come to scout you!

text_block_list.text: Huh? And just who on earth are you? Bold of you to make such a wild statement out of nowhere!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I can understand why she's frustrated at
the moment, so I remain
strong and
politely state my intentions.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You're persistent, I'll give you that.
But I'm sorry—I've had
enough with
trainers at the moment.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
And I'm certainly not about to sign up with
a greenhorn trainer like—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Actually, wait.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I plan to do some strength training
tomorrow at the campus gym.
Bring me
your proposed strength-training regimen.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
If you can prove some basic competence
as a trainer, then maybe
we'll talk.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I spend the entire night frantically
constructing a prospective training
course.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'll give you a pass. It looks like you
have what it takes to
manage a regimen at
least.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Here are the terms of our contract: you shall guide me in training, and concern yourself only with my training.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Everything else will be left up to me. That
includes my involvement in
the student
council and the management of my own
free time.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list:
So does this mean you're accepting my scouting
offer?

text_block_list.text:
Yes, as long as you stick to the terms. So
let's make this formal.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I am the Empress, Эйр Грув. I aim to
embody the ideals of all
Umamusume and
serve as a guiding beacon for all.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
While results on the track are of course
essential, they're far from all I
seek. If I
can't garner the admiration befitting an
empress, they mean
nothing.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You'll have a very specific role to play
amidst these aspirations. I trust
you
understand that?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I sense a bit of hesitancy. I'll overlook it
for now.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Not like I plan to actually rely on you...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Thus begin my days of supporting Air
Groove as she runs a noble
path.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Is that all for today? I'll be taking my
leave, then.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'm hardly compelled to tell you... but no
matter. I spend time guiding
some of the
more junior students.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
The academy offers instruction for runners
who haven't signed up with
a trainer, but
it's a uniform curriculum that can't account
for every
student's needs.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Some students find themselves struggling
with the lack of
personalized guidance. I
aim to simply keep them on track until
they
find a trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Now, if you'll excuse me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: What? A meeting? Now?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
No can do—I'm on my way to attend a
student council cleanup event.
Besides,
I've told you to give at least one day's
notice when making
schedule changes.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Compile all your points in a document and
send it to me later. I'll take
a look at least.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Our contract has only just begun, but I've
quickly come to appreciate
the concerns
her previous trainers have shown...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
